|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Flame Wall''' is a [[spell]] that creates a wall of flames which deals [[fire]] [[damage over time]] to enemies inside it, and for a short time after leaving it. Any [[projectile]]s that pass through the wall will gain added fire damage and apply Flame Wall's damage over time effect. ==Skill functions and interactions== {{status | name = Flame Wall | type = Debuff | icon = Burning Ground status icon.png | description = {{c|normal|You are taking Fire Damage while inside a Flame Wall.}} }} {{status | name = Flame Wall | type = Debuff | icon = Burning Ground status icon.png | description = {{c|normal|You are taking extra Fire Damage from a Flame Wall.}} }} ===Debuffs=== Flame Wall has a primary [[debuff]] (''You are taking Fire Damage while inside a Flame Wall'') and a secondary debuff (''You are taking extra Fire Damage from a Flame Wall''). Both debuffs are applied to enemies inside the Flame Wall, while the secondary debuff lingers on enemies even after they leave it. Casting a Flame Wall directly on an enemy will cause them to be inside its area, applying the primary debuff, and it will also count as them 'entering' the wall, applying the secondary debuff. Both debuffs can deal damage at the same time. Multiple copies of the same debuff cannot; only the highest dps primary and secondary debuffs will be active. The duration of the secondary debuff does not begin expiring until the enemy leaves Flame Wall's area.https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/iu8ekg/path_of_exile_heist_gem_information/g5jbgg9/?context=2 ===Projectiles=== Projectiles that travel through Flame Wall will gain added fire damage and apply Flame Wall's secondary debuff to enemies they [[hit]]. Expiration or replacement of a Flame Wall does not cancel its effects on projectiles that already passed through it. Projectiles that cannot directly collide with other objects (e.g. {{il|Molten Strike}}, {{il|Winter Orb}}) can still pass through a Flame Wall and gain its bonuses,https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aflS3IYGSng but rain-type projectiles such as {{il|Rain of Arrows}} can not. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Fire
